Tedama, meaning the country of the Teda (modern Ghadames), appears as Dydamum and Cydamus. Similarly, Garama means the country of the Gara, which is the official translation; however, it was translated as “place of the Gara” by Palmer on page 85, which is also correct but informal: https://archive.org/details/first-twelve-years-of-idris-alooma

The Debiri still endures today as two tribes bearing the same name. This is the tribe of the noble mother of the 16th Mai, Selmama of the Kanem-Bornu Empire. Peace be upon the noble souls of our ancestors.
